title: Three Wardens Fall - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Three Wardens Fall trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Three Wardens Fall phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Three fights, and Heartpiercer drops the Sundering Dual Axes, which is why many builds end up finishing this one first.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat the three Shadow Wardens: Cavalrybane, Soulclaimer and Heartpiercer.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 36 of 36 on the list - before it The Two Blade Masters. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
